36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
133676: Marin is an extravagant, messy, and while quite mature, she's also clumsy. She isn't very skilled at handiwork. Marin is a cosplayer and a huge otaku, being a fan of magical girl anime and adult video games. She is very kind, friendly, cheerful and outgoing.
133677: A famous cosplayer that Marin Kitagawa looks up to. Her younger sister is Shinju.
133678: Wakana Gojou is a fifteen-year-old high-schooler who is not very social, and doesn't fit in well with his fellow classmates, leading to him having no friends at the start of the story.
260976: Wakana was a childhood friend of hers, but when she discovered that Wakana, a man, was obsessed with hina dolls, she called him "disgusting" and ended their relationship.
261779: Miori is the cousin of Wakana Gojou. She supports him on his seemingly bizarre behavior (buying stockings).
263439: Amane Himeno is a cosplay name, his real name is Chitose Amano. He always cosplays as female characters. Unlike Marin who makes costume from scratch, he purchases costume as finished product.
264037: Shion is the main character from the in-story anime 'Flower Princess Blaze'. Sajuna wants Gojou to make a cosplay outfit based on this characters' 'Black Lily' form.
264038: Shion's sister and main enemy from the in-story anime 'Flower Princess Blaze'.
267568: A character from the manga "I'm a Mega-Best-Selling High-School-Student Light Novel Author That Has a Succubus Thirsting for Me Every Night and I Don't Know What to Do."
270817: Akira was passionate about anime and manga in her childhood but due to her mother and classmates' ill views towards this hobby she had to leave her love for manga and anime.
275521: The main heroine of fictional anime Flower Princess Retsu!!
275523: The main character of the in-universe "SuccIDK" manga series.
